title: LA Colossal – Vermilion Najeon 01 (Standing)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her early 40s, black hair in a sleek high bun with a coral binyeo, natural face with a bright smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy vermilion lacquer clearly different from skin, subtle brush texture beneath the shine, inlaid with thick cut mother-of-pearl in pink, green, and blue rainbow sheen — peonies, scrolling vines, and butterflies. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned. Authentic Korean Joseon style.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, one hand lightly touching her binyeo at shoulder height, the other on her outer hip, torso turned open to the camera. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch vermilion lacquer peep-toe platform stilettos with crossed ankle straps and mother-of-pearl heels.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, vermilion with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: Gyeongbokgung courtyard at golden hour, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm sunlight with raking side light so the mother-of-pearl flashes rainbow. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
